products.title: 经典扇形栅栏 4英尺
products.description:
乙烯基私密围栏

我们的乙烯基私密围栏既能提供全封闭的屏障，又兼具整洁现代的外观，非常适合用于后院、侧院以及任何需要完全私密性的场所。该产品坚固耐用、耐候性强且无需频繁维护，是替代传统木质围栏的明智之选。 

可选高度：4英尺、5英尺、6英尺
颜色：白色、棕褐色及双色搭配
适用场景：后院隔断、泳池围挡、边界私密防护
products.descriptionEn:
Vinyl Privacy Fence

Our vinyl privacy fences offer full enclosure and a clean, contemporary look ideal for backyards, side yards, and anywhere you need complete privacy. Durable, low-maintenance, and weather-resistant, they're a smart alternative to traditional wood.
features: Ideal For: Backyard separation, pool enclosures, perimeter privacy

products.title: gate-automation-For-Homes-Driveways
products.descriptionEn: Automatic gates bring style and safety to residential properties. From swing gates to sliding designs, homeowners can enjoy secure entry without leaving their vehicle. Remote control and keypad options make access effortless.

products.title: Access Gates & Entry Systems
products.descriptionEn:
Access Gates & Entry Systems
We custom-build swing, slide, and cantilever gates for commercial use, complete with automation and access control if needed.

products.title: ColorMax® Fire Resistant Metal Privacy Fence
products.titleEn: ColorMax® Fire Resistant Metal Privacy Fence
products.descriptionEn:
ColorMax® Fire Resistant Metal Privacy Fence

ColorMax® is the next generation of privacy fencing; combining the strength of steel with modern design. Unlike wood or vinyl, steel and aluminum do not ignite, warp, or melt when exposed to fire. ColorMax® panels are engineered to provide lasting privacy and safety while aligning with evolving California fire standards.
features: Constructed from galvanized steel for superior strength
Available in multiple colors and textures
Low-maintenance compared to wood or composite fencing
Provides complete privacy with a clean, modern appearance
